title: "Zukovica isotopes"
output: html_document
date: "2026-08-04"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
sst_raw <- read_csv(
  here("data", "raw", "zukovica_isotopes_all.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    excavation_unit = as.numeric(excavation_unit),
    `18Ovalue` = as.numeric(`18Ovalue`)
  ) |>
  group_by(excavation_unit, season) |>
  summarise(
    q0   = quantile(`18Ovalue`, 0.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25  = quantile(`18Ovalue`, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    q50  = quantile(`18Ovalue`, 0.50, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75  = quantile(`18Ovalue`, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    q100 = quantile(`18Ovalue`, 1.00, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    order = case_when(
      excavation_unit == 124   ~ 1,
      excavation_unit == 122   ~ 2,
      excavation_unit == 121   ~ 3,
      excavation_unit == 119   ~ 4,
      excavation_unit %in% c(116, 115) ~ 5,
      excavation_unit == 113.5 ~ 6,
      excavation_unit == 114   ~ 7,
      excavation_unit == 118   ~ 8,
      excavation_unit == 113   ~ 9,
      excavation_unit %in% c(108, 112, 25) ~ 10,
      excavation_unit %in% c(111, 24) ~ 11,
      excavation_unit == 23    ~ 12,
      excavation_unit == 110   ~ 13,
      excavation_unit == 22    ~ 14,
      excavation_unit == 109   ~ 15,
      excavation_unit %in% c(107, 20) ~ 16,
      excavation_unit == 19    ~ 17,
      excavation_unit == 106   ~ 18,
      excavation_unit == 17    ~ 19,
      excavation_unit == 105   ~ 20,
      excavation_unit == 16    ~ 21
    ),
    excavation_unit = factor(
      excavation_unit,
      levels = c(
        124,122,121,119,116,115,
        113.5,114,118,113,
        108,112,25,
        111,24,
        23,
        110,
        22,
        109,
        107,20,
        19,
        106,
        17,
        105,
        16
      )
    )
  ) |>
  arrange(order, excavation_unit, season)
```
```{r}

chronology <- tibble(
  order = 1:21,

  min_cal_bp = c(
    9450, 9300, 9150, 9000,
    8900,   # 116 / 115

    8670,   # 113.5 (Dated)
    8505,   # 114 (Interpolated)
    8340,   # 118 (Interpolated)
    8210,   # 113 (Dated)

    7820,   # 108 / 112 / 25 (Dated)
    7680,   # 111 / 24 (Dated)

    7550,
    7420,
    7290,
    7160,

    7030,

    6900,
    6770,
    6640,
    6510,
    6380
  ),

  max_cal_bp = c(
    9600, 9450, 9300, 9150,
    9000,   # 116 / 115

    8900,   # 113.5 (Dated)
    8670,   # 114 (Interpolated)
    8505,   # 118 (Interpolated)
    8340,   # 113 (Dated)

    8050,   # 108 / 112 / 25 (Dated)
    7740,   # 111 / 24 (Dated)

    7680,
    7550,
    7420,
    7290,

    7160,

    7030,
    6900,
    6770,
    6640,
    6510
  ),

  chronology = c(
    rep("Extrapolated", 5),
    "Dated",
    "Interpolated",
    "Interpolated",
    "Dated",
    "Dated",
    "Dated",
    rep("Extrapolated", 10)
  )
)

sst_plot <- sst_raw |>
  left_join(chronology, by = "order")

```



```{r}

rects <- bind_rows(
  sst_plot |>
    filter(!is.na(min_cal_bp)) |>
    transmute(
      excavation_unit,
      season,
      xmin = min_cal_bp,
      xmax = max_cal_bp,
      ymin = q0,
      ymax = q100,
      band = "0–100%"
    ),

  sst_plot |>
    filter(!is.na(min_cal_bp)) |>
    transmute(
      excavation_unit,
      season,
      xmin = min_cal_bp,
      xmax = max_cal_bp,
      ymin = q25,
      ymax = q75,
      band = "25–75%"
    )
)

meds <- sst_plot |>
  filter(!is.na(min_cal_bp)) |>
  transmute(
    excavation_unit,
    season,
    xmin = min_cal_bp,
    xmax = max_cal_bp,
    y = q50
  )

```

```{r}
p <- ggplot() +

  geom_rect(
    data = rects,
    aes(
      xmin = xmin,
      xmax = xmax,
      ymin = ymin,
      ymax = ymax,
      fill = season
    ),
    alpha = 0.15
  ) +

  geom_segment(
    data = meds,
    aes(
      x = xmin,
      xend = xmax,
      y = y,
      yend = y,
      colour = season
    ),
    linewidth = 0.6
  ) +

  geom_text(
    data = meds,
    aes(
      x = (xmin + xmax) / 2,
      y = y - 0.05,
      label = excavation_unit
    ),
    size = 3
  ) +

  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    Winter = "deepskyblue",
    Summer = "lightcoral"
  )) +

  scale_colour_manual(values = c(
    Winter = "deepskyblue",
    Summer = "lightcoral"
  )) +

  scale_x_reverse() +
  scale_y_reverse() +

  labs(
    x = "cal BP",
    y = expression(delta^18*O),
    fill = NULL,
    colour = "Season",
    title = expression(Zukovica~delta^18*O)
  ) +

  theme_cowplot()

p

```

```{r save_plot}

ggsave(
  filename = here("results", "zukovica_isotopes_plot.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)
```
